notes: Measured with Playwright on --only previews of main and the branch (8 flagships, 390x844 and 1280x800). At 390, first cards moved up 33-171 px. At 1280, five pages are 8-42 px taller (reported). The new lede-word test fails for all 7 edited pages on main and passes on the branch. Local: 47 venture test files that read index.html, 795 pass / 0 fail; platform/pages/*.test.mjs, 1880 pass / 0 fail; clauses.mjs over the 7 ventures, 176 pages carry their clauses. CI: everything green except changed-ventures. ci_starvation says it got a runner, so it was a real failure, but it was a timing one: shift-roster-builder/repair-flow.test.mjs:140 'repair reserve' got null where it expected 1000, after an 11 s build on a loaded runner. The test's comments already record this flake (PRs #16481, #16599), and it passes locally. This PR changes only HTML and CSS, which the solver never reads. Merged on the local checks; the flake should get its own fix (for example, assert on repairReserveFor alone, as the small-week case already does).
